rationale: The core is right: VST-normalized counts, an unweighted z-score composite over the 20 genes with missing genes reported, a Cox model of Surv(time, event) ~ score + condition, a Schoenfeld PH check, event counts flagged as the power limit, and KM by tertile within strata as a display after the model. It falls short of the reference by not standardizing the score to report HR per SD, not reporting median follow-up, offering no stratified or time-dependent remedy for a PH violation, still reporting log-rank tests on median splits, and appending an ill-powered 12000-gene cross-validated elastic-net step on ~120 samples that adds little. There is no sample-structure QC (PCA, library sizes, outlier policy) and no low-count gene filter before VST. Enrichment is correctly omitted with justification; the report lacks package versions and a stated LR-vs-Wald p-value choice.
